points.description: States that testing influences the coding stage (phase 5) and the solution refinement stage (phase 7) — both stages named.
points.partial_credit: Half (2 marks) if only one of the two stages is named correctly, or both are given vaguely (e.g. 'implementation' and 'improving the solution'); no credit for wrong stages.

points.description: Identifies the stages by their phase numbers or clear names: coding = phase 5, solution refinement = phase 7.
points.partial_credit: Half (0.5) if only one stage is correctly matched to its number/name.

rubric.notes: Full marks for naming both coding (phase 5) and solution refinement (phase 7) as influenced by testing; different wording such as 'programming' or 'refining/improving the solution' is fine. Part marks for naming only one of the two, or for vague descriptions. No marks for answers that name other stages only or merely describe what testing is.
